question: ___________ is a record of assets and liabilities of any firm.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Balance sheet.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​The** balance sheet **is a **financial statement **that lists a company's** assets, liabilities, equity capital, total debt, **and other items as of a particular point in time.
 
• **Liabilities** are listed on the **opposite side **of the balance sheet from **assets.**
 
• One of the three primary **financial statements** used to assess a company is the balance sheet.
 
• It offers a **summary of a company's financial situation** as of the publication date.
 
• The **assets **on the balance sheet are equal to the **total of the liabilities** plus the shareholders' equity.
 
• **Financial ratios** are computed using** balance sheets** by fundamental analysts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Balance of payment:**

 
 
• It is a list of every transaction that took place between **entities in one nation **and the rest of the world during a** specific time frame, such a quarter or a year.**
 
• Both the **current account and the capital account **are part of the balance of payments.
 
• The balance of payments' total recorded transactions must **equal zero.**
 
 
 
• **Bank bailout:**
 
 
• A bailout is when financial assistance is given to an** organisation **or nation that might otherwise be in **financial trouble. ​**
 
• **Loans, bonds, stocks, or cash** can all be used as bailout funds.
 
• Certain loans need to be** repaid, with or without interest charges**.
